description: What a request needs beyond the available balance, in integer n$ (D-69). PHP's CreditBalance::shortfallFor and TS's creditShortfall must both give `shortfall`; money.ts's formatUsdRoundedUp must show it as `display`, rounded up to the next $0.0001. `required` is AC 6's max user price unless a case says otherwise.

cases.name: equal: the balance covers the max exactly (AC 10)
the second of two concurrent creates (AC 12)
a negative balance after an above-hold charge (AC 13)
